name: Navitas Petroleum, Limited Partnership
summary: Navitas Petroleum, Limited Partnership, an independent oil and gas partnership, engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and gas. Its asset portfolio includes Shenandoah, Buckskin, Monument, and Shenandoah South in the waters of the Gulf of America south of the coast of Texas and Louisiana and in onshore oil fields in Texas; and Gas and Oil Assets in the Northern Southwest Atlantic Ocean. The company also has rights to an offshore exploration license in the Philippines and an option to join as a partner in another offshore oil asset located off the coast of Morocco. Navitas Petroleum, Limited Partnership was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.
